metadata.description: Removes masked objects. For two erase modes: https://fal.ai/models/bria/fibo-edit-1.5/eraser
Removes mask-selected objects and their visual effects, seamlessly reconstructing the scene with contextually appropriate content.
Generate images from text, an image and a mask using Z-Image Turbo, Tongyi-MAI's super-fast 6B model.
Edits images from one to three reference images and a natural-language instruction, preserving key details such as facial features and identity while applying the requested changes

FLUX General Inpainting is a versatile endpoint that enables precise image editing and completion, supporting multiple AI extensions including LoRA, ControlNet, and IP-Adapter for enhanced control over inpainting results and sophisticated image modifications.
Luma Uni-1 Edit reworks a source image from a text instruction, preserving the original composition while applying style changes and following optional reference images to steer the result.

MAI-Image-2.5 is Microsoft's photorealistic image generation and editing model that turns text prompts or uploaded images into high-quality, design-ready visuals with fine-grained, pixel-level control.
